title: How to follow up with your Investing Quiz leads
titleHtml: How to follow up with your Investing Quiz leads
sub: Use these scripts immediately after receiving a new investing quiz lead.

video.title: Funnel scripts training video
video.caption: Watch this before you start calling.

steps.title: Call them
steps.lead: They probably won't pick up, so leave this voicemail:
script: I saw you took our investing quiz, so I wanted to follow up and send you some information you may find useful.

Since you were exploring whether investing might be right for you, I thought you might be interested in a way to learn more about investing while getting real-time alerts on market opportunities and activity.
It's designed to help you stay informed and learn as you go, rather than trying to figure everything out on your own.
If you're curious about how it works, just reply back to my text and I'll send you the details. No pressure at all!

If you don't see my text, check your Unknown Senders or Spam folder. On an iPhone, look for the filter or menu icon in the top right corner of your Messages app. On an Android, look for the three-dot menu. You should be able to find any filtered messages there, which is where my text might be.
Okay, that's all for now! Let me know if you got the text. Talk soon!

steps.title: Text them
steps.lead: As soon as you hang up, send this:
script: Hey [Name], it's [Your Name]! 👋 Just left you a quick voicemail. I saw you took our investing quiz, so I wanted to send you some information you may find useful.

Since you were exploring whether investing might be right for you, I thought you might be interested in a way to learn more about investing while getting real-time alerts on market opportunities and activity.
It's designed to help you stay informed and learn as you go, rather than trying to figure everything out on your own.
If you're curious about how it works, just reply INVESTING and I'll send you the details!

steps.title: Follow up in 24 hrs
steps.lead: If they don't respond within 24 hours, text again:
script: [Name]! Just following up on the above! 👆 Were you able to check out the information I sent over? If you're interested in learning more about investing and getting real-time alerts on market opportunities and activity, shoot me a text back and I'll send you the details!

tip: Tip: Personalize [Name] and [Your Name] every time. The investing follow-up copy is already in the scripts - just hit Copy script and send it as-is.
footer: Investing Quiz follow-up · Quick reference · Keep this handy by your phone
